# Ignite Yourself

> Founder-led creative studio that turns the authority an established professional has already earned into an owned digital asset. The studio's principle: we do not invent authority, we reveal it.

Ignite Yourself researches, writes, designs, and builds personal digital platforms for professionals whose accumulated experience, evidence, reputation, and point of view live scattered across institutions, practices, profiles, and other people's platforms.

## What the studio sells

The Authority Platform — USD 3,000 (USD 1,500 to begin, USD 1,500 after final approval, before launch). One focused production week; most platforms are completed within 7–10 business days after the Authority Interview and receipt of the required materials. Optional Platform Care after launch: USD 99/month.

Included: Public Research & Authority Brief, Authority Interview (one 30–45 minute conversation), Positioning & Narrative, Core Copy & Evidence Architecture, Editorial Visual Direction, Owned Digital Platform, Professional Pathways, Launch & Handover.

Not included: ongoing social media management, full content strategy, PR, paid media, guaranteed rankings, unlimited revisions, or recurring traffic generation.

## Who it is for

Defined by professional stage, not industry or age. Surgeons, founders, executives, academics, advisors, specialists, and independent professionals who have earned authority, whose representation is fragmented across places, who are entering a meaningful next chapter, and who want an asset they own rather than another channel to feed.
